## About
Autoserv is family-owned and operated, located on University Boulevard one block from Georgia Avenue, serving drivers in Wheaton and Silver Spring.
We handle repairs big and small on every make and model, foreign and domestic. That covers tune-ups, oil changes, brakes, tires, transmission work and the scheduled maintenance your dealer would do. We keep tires, batteries and other parts in stock, and there is parking behind the shop for easy drop-off and pick-up.
Neighbors have rated us 4.6 from 88 Google reviews. Give us a call or stop by.

## Services
- Maryland state safety inspection: State safety inspections for your car.
- Factory-scheduled maintenance: The maintenance your manufacturer recommends, done on schedule.
- Brake service: Brake service, repair and replacement.
- Engine diagnostics and repair: Complete engine diagnostics, repair and replacement, using current scanning and diagnostic equipment.
- Transmission repair: Transmission repair and replacement.
- Tires: New tires, batteries and other accessories, with stock kept in the shop.
- Suspension and steering: Adjustment and repair for suspension and steering.
- Heating and AC service: Keep your heat and air conditioning working.
- Emissions repairs: Repairs to get your car through emissions.
- Fleet service: Maintenance plans built around your business vehicles, with parking for them to come and go.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service all cars, foreign and domestic.

Q: Will servicing my car here affect my dealer warranty?
A: No. Federal law prohibits car dealers from denying your warranty because work was done at an independent shop like ours.

Q: Can I get my car back the same day?
A: For most items, yes. Drop your car off in the morning and we can usually finish the repair that day.

Q: Is there a place to wait?
A: Yes. We have a waiting area with WiFi.
